description: Migrate groups from the source environment to the target environment using the bulk endpoint.

examples.user_query: Migrate all user groups from the source environment to the target environment.
examples.notes: This tool takes no arguments — source and target come from the configured connections.

examples.user_query: Copy every group over to the new environment.
examples.notes: This tool takes no arguments — source and target come from the configured connections.

description: Migrate specific groups from the source environment to the target environment.

examples.user_query: Migrate the 'Sales Team' and 'Marketing Team' groups to the target environment.
examples.notes: This call migrates the 'Sales Team' and 'Marketing Team' groups from the source environment to the target environment. Use this when you need to move specific groups to a new Sisense instance.

examples.user_query: I need to transfer the 'Admin' and 'Data Analysts' groups to our updated Sisense server. How do I do that?
examples.notes: This call migrates the 'Admin' and 'Data Analysts' groups to the target environment. Useful for ensuring key user groups are available in the new setup.

examples.user_query: Can I move the 'Support Team' group to the new Sisense environment?
examples.notes: This call migrates the 'Support Team' group to the target environment. Ideal for transferring a single group when preparing the new environment.
